text:
Too Many Artists Working on episode 3’s Art

If Episode 3’s inconsistent faces and body proportions didn’t bother you then good news. They probably never will because episode 3 had an absurd number of different outsourced artists working on it. One of the highest numbers JoJo has ever had. The other episodes most likely won’t have nearly as many. Just to be clear, I’m talking about inconsistencies in faces and body proportions within a single episode, not between different episodes. In general, as the episodes progress, you’ll get episodes with a lot of outsourced artists because of deadlines but considering SBR episodes are packaged into batches, there’s really no need to worry about this issue here. This episode will probably just remain one of the episodes with the highest number of different animators working on it because it was a less important episode. Plus, I believe the art style will become more consistent and stable as the episodes go on, just like we’ve seen with the other parts. I’m pretty happy with the quality so far. What do you all think

Funny Valentine isn’t as perfect as people say (to me)

I just finished part 7 of jojos its very good top 3 parts so far but i was left kind of disappointed at how he is written emotionally i do think he is very well written this is more of a preference statement than anything but i wanted to share it. Funny valentine during the Lucy SA part as he is portrayed as someone with very human impulses of lust and attraction to her and her actions yet I find it weird that when he is about to die he is presented so calmly talking to Diego I get he states he is confident he can convince Johnny on his deal but if he is human enough to feel that level of attraction I feel like he should be given more emotion shown as he is giving away essentially his life goal to Diego which led me to expect him to show more despiration. Alternatively I think a complete opposite approach would have worked well too, i would have liked him to act more coldly to his supposed wife instead of trying to pursue sex with her and constantly calling Lucy cute kind of like the relationship between light and misa from death note where he treats her transactionally and uses her and shown to dislike her as if light was heartless to me this would justify his composure of the Diego scene as before wouldn’t be shown so emotionally open and more purely inhumane and sort of like a patriotism machine and this would justify sacrificing human desires for his ideology. I don’t think valentine lacks depth at all I think he is one of the better villains in the part one of my least favourites so maybe I’m biased but I just think his emotional state was caught into 2 different versions and I just wish araki went further into one of complete coldness pursueing everything for only the americas sake for absolutely all or still show he is human more and display that despite this he still loves his country.
